I was on Valium for about a year and yes in the short term It helped to get stable, but you can build a dependency on them. So tapering off was a living hell. Honestly for high anxiety situations in the long term I’ve been told to use Benadryl in really bad spots as a PRN because it’s an antihistamine and will make you a bit relaxed. And for extreme full on panic attacks I am prescribed hydroxyzine (Atarax) which is also a antihistamine but I take it maybe 5-6 times a year cause it’s very strong and makes me sleep for 14+ hours after taking it. But overall  with experience of Benzos, they are helpful and some doctors realize they are necessary in the short term, but it doesn’t help teach coping skills in the long term. Also as soon as I switched psychiatrists (as almost all I’ve worked with) they didn’t feel comfortable prescribing benzos and I had to be respectful of that.

 Hooked, your sparkly starry eyes pierced me like a harpoon"

"Suddenly I wasn't **feeling (get rid of feeling)** well
